composition.serve_who: Sheet GMMS 108'-114b "BILGE / WATER VALVE SYSTEM" serves the WATER TRANSFER VALVES system: five motorized fresh-water valves (FRESH WATER VALVE, FRESH WATER PORT BUNKER, FRESH WATER STBD BUNKER, FRESH WATER PORT SUCTION, FRESH WATER STBD SUCTION) each controlled through a dedicated relay (Re7-Re11) off terminal strip T/S B, fed from breaker Q14 10A labelled "WATER TRANSFER VALVES". This matches the engineer mapping WATER TRANSFER VALVES -> 510-water-transfer-valves, and the established fact that this Q14 10A breaker feeds this exact load (per 510-water-transfer-valves electrical_supply fact). All five valve groups are functionally identical rows of the same equipment/system and are composed as one node.

functions.label: Fresh Water Valve open/close control
functions.what_it_does: Motorized valve (M) opens or closes the main fresh water line; commanded remotely via relay Re7 and reports status via XA41 feedback tap.
functions.sheet_region: T/S B row 14, terminals 51-55, top group (~y0.14-0.22)

flow_scenarios.path: Remote command via XA60 pin 02 -> terminal 51 -> OPEN contact (1) -> motor M terminal 3 -> valve drives open
Remote command via XA60 pin 04 -> terminal 52 -> CLOSE contact (4) -> motor M terminal 2 -> valve drives closed
Q14 10A -> T/S B terminal 14 -> Re7 relay contact group -> terminals 53/54 -> motor M; motor's positive/feed side back to Re7 coil not traced on this sheet (coil/contacts run off-crop)
Terminal 55 -> XA41 pin 10 (status tap to monitoring, direction per drawn line into XA41)

key_components: OPEN/CLOSE remote contacts via XA60 pins 02/04

Terminal 60 -> XA41 pin 12

infrastructure.system_name: T/S B Terminal Strip / Relay Bank (Re7-Re11) — distribution & control rack for water transfer valves
facts: Supply chain: +24V SERVICE BAT. -> F6 300A fuse -> breaker Q14 10A (WATER TRANSFER VALVES) -> T/S B terminals 14-18
T/S B distributes to five relays Re7 (T14), Re8 (T15), Re9 (T16), Re10 (T17), Re11 (T18)
Terminals 17 and 18 on T/S B are FUSED terminals (built-in replaceable fuse) — known troubleshooting culprits for Port/Stbd Suction valve circuits
XA60 multi-pin plug supplies OPEN/CLOSE remote command pairs (pins 02/04, 06/08, 10/12, 14/16, 18/20) into terminals 51-72 for the five valves
XA41 multi-pin plug receives status/feedback taps from terminals 55, 60, 65, 70, 75 (one per valve)
